items.name: fleek-ui
items.title: Fleek UI stylesheet
items.description: Tokens + Tailwind utilities + fui-* primitives. Wrap your app root in .fleek-ui; starter theme ships as :root/.dark defaults and hosts override via [data-theme] or --palette-* hooks.
